name: ci-hub
description: Companion Intelligence Hub CLI and self-hosted app platform runtime.

scripts.dev:app: POSTGRES_HOST=localhost RABBITMQ_HOST=localhost NODE_ENV=development turbo run local
scripts.infra:up: ENV_FILE=.env.local docker compose --env-file .env.local --project-name ci-hub -f docker-compose.local.yml up -d ci-os-hub-queue ci-hub-db && ENV_FILE=.env.local pnpm exec tsx scripts/sync-postgres-password.ts .env.local
scripts.start:docker: sh -c 'eval "$(pnpm exec tsx scripts/compose-runtime-env.ts .env.local)" && docker compose --env-file .env.local --project-name ci-hub -f docker-compose.local.yml up --build && ENV_FILE=.env.local pnpm exec tsx scripts/sync-postgres-password.ts .env.local'
scripts.init:host: pnpm exec tsx scripts/init-hub-data-dirs.ts && pnpm exec tsx scripts/init-traefik.ts && pnpm exec tsx scripts/init-docker-config.ts && pnpm exec tsx scripts/init-gpu-runtime.ts && pnpm exec tsx scripts/init-host-probe.ts && pnpm exec tsx scripts/tune-docker-resources.ts
scripts.start:prod: pnpm run init:host && sh -c 'eval "$(pnpm exec tsx scripts/compose-runtime-env.ts .env.prod)" && docker compose --env-file .env.prod --project-name ci-hub -f docker-compose.prod.yml up --build && ENV_FILE=.env.prod pnpm exec tsx scripts/sync-postgres-password.ts .env.prod'
scripts.start:staging: pnpm run init:host && sh -c 'eval "$(pnpm exec tsx scripts/compose-runtime-env.ts .env.staging)" && docker compose --env-file .env.staging --project-name ci-hub -f docker-compose.prod.yml up --build && ENV_FILE=.env.staging pnpm exec tsx scripts/sync-postgres-password.ts .env.staging'
scripts.start:dev: pnpm run init:host && sh -c 'eval "$(pnpm exec tsx scripts/compose-runtime-env.ts .env.dev)" && docker compose --env-file .env.dev --project-name ci-hub -f docker-compose.prod.yml up --build && ENV_FILE=.env.dev pnpm exec tsx scripts/sync-postgres-password.ts .env.dev'
scripts.start:dev:detached: pnpm run init:host && sh -c 'eval "$(pnpm exec tsx scripts/compose-runtime-env.ts .env.dev)" && docker compose --env-file .env.dev --project-name ci-hub -f docker-compose.prod.yml up -d --build && ENV_FILE=.env.dev pnpm exec tsx scripts/sync-postgres-password.ts .env.dev'
scripts.test:e2e: bash e2e/pre-test-cleanup.sh && pnpm exec tsx scripts/run-e2e.ts
scripts.e2e:cross-domain: bash e2e/pre-test-cleanup.sh && E2E_SUITE=cross-domain pnpm exec playwright test --config playwright.cross-domain.config.ts
scripts.check:all: pnpm run lint && turbo run tsc && turbo run build && turbo run test
scripts.fresh: pnpm run cleanup && pnpm start dev
scripts.fresh:local: pnpm run cleanup && pnpm start local
